why: A self-reference looks back at the field's own earlier value (L747-749), here at its fixed-up path; the fallback to the original path is for an included file that "might intend to refer to the application's root config" (L1043-1047), which a field referring to itself does not. typesafe/config reads it so: b = ${?b} included in a has nothing below it at a.b, so it "just disappears silently" (L776), and the root's b {} is not taken: a is {}.
